hero.title: Axopar 25 Cross Top
hero.heading: AXOPAR 25 CROSS TOP - Comfort and Freedom In One
hero.intro: For anyone looking for something more than just a straightforward day-boat. The Axopar 25 range is our foray into the thriving world of cuddy cruisers and another leap forward in value for money, now offering more space, greater overall comfort, and more all-round capability.

sections.title: It's Time for a Shake Up
sections.intro: The characteristic Axopar 25 is a true crossover between comfortable day boating and extended island-hopping, where the seaworthiness and handling come to the fore. With its raised ‘cuddy cabin’ sleeping accommodation defining the character of the boat, this dynamic and sporty cruiser is now offering more space, more overall comfort and more all-round capability.

sections.title: Comfortable Cuddy Cabin
sections.intro: The comfortable cuddy cabin allows for extended overnight adventures and comes standard with a sink and toilet. The full-width cushioned sundeck positioned atop the cabin roof, has a sloping backrest that serves as a perfect sunbathing and hangout place on the boat.

sections.title: Seaworthiness & Handling
sections.intro: With the Axopar's renowned handling and driving capabilities, the 25 is predictable, unintimidating, and rewarding to drive. It assures good directional stability, a fantastic grip during cornering, and a good time on the water.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hull of Fame
sections.intro:
Every Axopar begins where the boating experience truly begins: below the waterline. Many boaters have learned to accept certain compromises as normal. Our hull-first approach gets the fundamentals right from the start. Since the first Axopar 28 was launched in 2014, this philosophy has shaped our multi-award-winning range, helped create the adventure boating category, and contributed to more than 7,600 Axopar boats being sold worldwide.

Discover the Hull of Fame and the engineering behind the distinctive Axopar driving experience.

sections.title: Videos Featuring the Axopar 25 Cross Top

items.caption: For anyone who loves relaxing in the sun, the fore deck of the Axopar 25 is the perfect escape. Positioned above the cuddy cabin, it offers a generous, open platform designed for effortless lounging.
A driver‑focused helm that gives you instant confidence. Smart ergonomics, easy‑to‑read instruments, and a balanced driving position make the Axopar 25 a pleasure to operate in all conditions.
The perfect upgrade for long days on the water. The top‑loaded refrigerator keeps drinks chilled, while the integrated sink adds practical convenience for quick rinsing and simple prep.
A practical standard feature that adds comfort and independence to every trip. The toilet with a compact sink provides essential convenience for day‑long adventures.

items.title: BRABUS Line
modal_text: Includes black cleats, side rails, pulpits (option), waterski frame (option), rub rail (option), ventilation and speaker grills, and the Axopar hull logo in black. Additionally,  a steering wheel with BRABUS embossing, a BRABUS map pocket, and BRABUS badges on the boat.

items.title: BRABUS Line Color Edition
modal_text: For style-conscious customers looking to make their Axopar 25 truly stand out, the Brabus Line Color Edition introduces four striking hull colors: the vibrant, playful Miami Blue; the more subtle, sophisticated Platinum Grey. The fresh, contemporary Glacier Blue; and the timeless, elegant Pearl White. These duo-tone color options combine colored areas with uncolored sections in a standard white finish, giving the boat a dynamic and distinctive look.

items.title: BRABUS Performance Line
modal_text: The BRABUS Performance Line features stylish hull and roof graphics and an extra boost of power at the transom, courtesy of a Mercury Verado 250hp engine, to get you to your adventure destination promptly.

items.title: The Mediterrana Edition
modal_text:
The upholstery features exclusive, subtle yet stylish detailing, accentuated patterns, and a structured feel of marine fabrics. The fabric keeps the interior and lounging areas at comfortable temperatures, even on the warmest summer days.

The Mediterrana Edition features and options:

Outdoor waterproof fabric

Fore deck sun deck cushions with cupholders.

Mediterrana Soft Decking

Extended sun bed cushions on Multi Storage Compartment

Extended sun bed cushions for u-sofa

Harbor covers

sections.title: Alternatives for Aft Deck
sections.intro: The modular nature of Axopars and our multi-platform thinking enable you to customize your boat with an aft layout to suit your everyday needs. As standard, the Axopar 25 Cross Top comes with an aft sofa. The aft deck can also be equipped with an optional Multi Storage Compartment or a U-sofa, with the option to extend it into a sun bed.
